notes: 529 on every attempt: claude retries, gives up with "API Error: Repeated 529 Overloaded errors …" painted as the reply and a settled end-of-turn summary, and writes one tagged entry (isApiErrorMessage, error: server_error) to its transcript when it gives up. Recorded on Linux, where claude draws message bullets as "●" rather than macOS's "⏺". Recorded with `HW_RECORD_API_RETRY=1 go test ./pkg/chat -run RecordAPIErrorRetry` (pkg/chat/apierror_retry_record_test.go): the real claude against a local Messages API, in /tmp/hw-rebake/api-error-retry-gives-up with a fresh CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (onboarding done, the directory trusted, permissions.defaultMode auto) and a placeholder ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, so no account or tokens are involved.
